summary.tldr: Requires public inquiry commissioners to be appointed only after consultation with recognized party leaders and approval by the House of Commons.
what_it_does: Changes the Inquiries Act so the Governor in Council can appoint public inquiry commissioners only after consulting the leader of every recognized party in the House of Commons.
Requires the House of Commons to approve the commissioner appointment by resolution before the inquiry can proceed.
Applies to inquiries that are not covered by a special law.
summary.background: The bill replaces section 3 of the Inquiries Act. It applies to inquiries described in section 2 that are not regulated by any special law.
